name: Ljubljana Blind Open 2025
information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc1piIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d29197442f9c0cca01548d66ec5476309b322c33/EN.png)

This competition is being organized by the Rubik klub Slovenija.
If you need any additional information, or if you would like to change your registration, please write an e-mail to the **wca.slovenia@gmail.com**.

**Note:** This competition is aimed towards more experienced competitors. If you haven't competed before then you are welcome to do so, but we recommend choosing out a more beginner-friendly competition which has the standard 3x3x3 event. **This competition does NOT have a 3x3x3 event!**

For more information, please check the tabs!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc2RiIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--94ed0fe65a7490a7d754bd5102bbf816e502a7be/SI.png)

Tekmovanje organizira Rubik klub Slovenija.
Če potrebujete dodatne informacije ali če bi želeli spremeniti svojo prijavo, nam pišite na **wca.slovenia@gmail.com**.

**Opomba:** To tekmovanje je namenjeno bolj izkušenim tekmovalcem. Če še niste tekmovali, ste prav tako dobrodošli, vendar vam priporočamo, da izberete začetnikom bolj prijazno tekmovanje, ki ima klasično disciplino 3x3x3. **Na tem tekmovanju NI discipline 3x3x3!**

Za več informacij preverite zavihke!
